title: Direct Delta writes from a Go service beside Spark on the same tables
summary: A Delta Lake project blog post describes how an electric-vehicle manufacturer replaced a dual-format, always-on Spark landing path for vehicle packet captures with an open-source Go connector writing straight to Delta tables under a DynamoDB-coordinated log store.
reporter: Delta Lake project blog (author not verified)
